name: code-diff-card
title: Code Diff Card
description: A before-and-after code diff card that makes one implementation change easy to explain.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: Use short before and after snippets and a plain-language summary of why the change matters.

variables.label: Summary
variables.default: Keep preview playback stable while edits arrive.

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses authored timings; this is not word alignment.

events.action: Restore both code panes for comparison

useWhen: Explain one small before/after code change in the same file.
avoidWhen: Do not present unrelated code as a diff, claim tests passed without running them or cram in whole files.

inputRules.filename: Supply real file name within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.before: Actual code in the same file: at most four lines, 58 characters per line. Keep the paired change comparable.
inputRules.after: Actual code in the same file: at most four lines, 58 characters per line. Keep the paired change comparable.
inputRules.summary: Supply real summary within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

cueBindings.before: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Show the old code behavior. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.after: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Show the replacement code. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.explain: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Explain the behavioral difference. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real explanation boundary; use a walkthrough for larger code, never silently truncate lines.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

values.summary: 避免可用座位显示为负数；是否有效仍需测试。

example.narration: 原来直接相减，修改后把结果限制为不小于零，避免显示负座位数。

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Identify the file → Read the old behavior → Read the changed behavior → Explain the difference and compare. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
